have bowled first. The first 5-6 overs, it always does something. We have two good fast 
bowlers, Kasun Rajitha and Lahiru Kumara, so our plan is to get early wickets with them 
and then our spinners come into the game so that's how I would like to operate. [On the 
top order] They've been outstanding, Dimuth Karunaratne and Pathum Nissanka, in the 
recent past. Dimuth comes into the game and and he carries the game to the middle 
overs. That's a key area we could have done better. That's the key to success. I would 
like to see my two fast bowlers getting wickets up front with the movement. Today we 
got a wicket with a short ball. We could have bowled in that right area a bit and got a 
couple of wickets. I think that's the key. And Hasaranga, we know he is going to do the 
job always. [On the short ball plan] I think with the surface, we need to try our short 
balls. As the tournament progresses, we need to go with the right plan."
